description: estate-ci#261 (STD-OPS-02, DR-51): the repositories the estate version detector covers. renovate.yml runs one Renovate pass per repository whose batch is in active_batches, each with its own one-repository vallery-pin-bot token. A repository joins by moving its batch into active_batches after its own renovate.json PR merges (until then Renovate skips it: requireConfig=required). Entries with batch "exception" are not run; each needs a Jason decision and a STD-OPS-02 exception row in estate-platform docs/estate/STANDARDS.md naming estate-ci#261. Every active (non-archived) owner repository from the root AGENTS.md lane table appears exactly once.
